regulatory_summary: The WeatherCubeSat-1 6U cubesat requires comprehensive regulatory compliance across national licensing, frequency coordination, export controls, launch safety, and debris mitigation. Primary obligations include obtaining national space operation licenses from USA authorities, coordinating frequencies through ITU filings, complying with export controls (ITAR/EAR for US components), meeting launch provider safety requirements, and demonstrating post-mission disposal capability. Jurisdiction-specific requirements apply: USA licensing governs satellite operations, USA regulations cover launch safety, and international ITU rules manage spectrum use. Lead times vary from 3-12 months for major filings, with national licensing typically being the longest pole. Insurance requirements (minimum $100M third-party liability) must be secured before launch. All regulatory approvals must be complete at least 30 days before launch for integration clearance.

risks_and_mitigations.description: USA licensing authority review exceeds 12 months, delaying launch
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Engage regulatory consultant early, submit complete application with all required documentation, request pre-application meeting

risks_and_mitigations.description: Other satellite operators file objections to frequency assignments
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Conduct thorough interference analysis, engage in bilateral coordination early, consider alternative frequencies

risks_and_mitigations.description: Unintended ITAR/EAR violations during component procurement or data sharing
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Implement export compliance program, train all staff, conduct component classification review

risks_and_mitigations.description: Failure to meet range safety deadlines results in lost launch slot
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Maintain close coordination with launch provider, submit safety documentation 30 days early

risks_and_mitigations.description: Space insurance premiums increase or coverage becomes unavailable
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Secure insurance broker early, consider alternative insurance structures, budget contingency

key_action: Immediately initiate USA national license application process, as this has the longest lead time (6-12 months). Engage regulatory counsel to prepare submission package including technical specifications, orbital parameters, frequency plan, and debris mitigation strategy.
